summary.en: Two Philippine Coast Guard bomb experts were wounded in an accidental explosion at their Zamboanga City barracks, and two Coast Guard members were injured in a separate accidental blast in the same city. Chinese carrier and militia vessels were observed transiting near Mindanao and Zamboanga coasts, prompting AFP monitoring of their movements. The Philippines, United States and Japan completed their 22nd multilateral maritime cooperative activity in the West Philippine Sea, reinforcing joint presence there. Taiwan shut schools and grounded flights as Typhoon Champi passed nearby, affecting regional stability. There were 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: To bombeksperter fra Filippinenes kystvakt ble såret i en utilsiktet eksplosjon på deres barakk i Zamboanga City, og to medlemmer av kystvakten ble skadet i en separat utilsiktet eksplosjon i samme by. Kinesiske hangarskip og militsfartøy ble observert på transitt nær kysten av Mindanao og Zamboanga, noe som førte til at AFP overvåket deres bevegelser. Filippinene, USA og Japan fullførte sin 22. multilaterale maritime samarbeidsaktivitet i Vestfilippinene, og styrket den felles tilstedeværelsen der. Taiwan stengte skoler og avlyste flyvninger da Tyfon Champi passerte i nærheten, noe som påvirket regional stabilitet. Det var 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
